inputs.text: Stalin’s DMK manifesto includes meaningful relief for people squeezed by inequality: women’s monthly aid would double to Rs 2,000, households would get Rs 8,000 coupons, and farmers would receive free motor pumpsets. It also promises more support for fishermen and jobs. But welfare needs to be part of a broader commitment to secure livelihoods and public investment—not just a cushion while economic decisions prioritize FDI and AI development. The real test is whether these promises strengthen workers and vulnerable communities in practice.
